text:
Predicates:
AllowedToMoveIn(x, y) ::: x is allowed to move in with pet y.
Pet(x) ::: x is a pet.
InBuilding(y, z) ::: y is in building z.
Managed(z) ::: z is a managed building.
MonthlyRent(z, r) ::: the monthly rent at building z is r.
Deposit(z, d) ::: the security deposit at building z is d.
Equal(r1, r2) ::: r1 is equal to r2.
MoreOrEqual(r1, r2) ::: r1 is more than or equal to r2.
Rent(x, y) ::: x is a rent amount at building y.
AllowsPets(z) ::: building z allows pets.
PeopleAllowedWithPet(z) ::: people are allowed to move in with a pet in building z.
Premises:
Pets(x) ∧ Fluffy(x) ::: Fluffy is a pet.
OliveGarden ::: The Olive Garden.
Managed(OliveGarden) ::: The Olive Garden is a managed building.
MonthlyRent(OliveGarden, 2000) ::: The monthly rent at The Olive Garden is $2000.
MoreOrEqual(2000, 1500) ::: $2000 is more than $1500.
AllowedToMoveIn(Tom, Fluffy) ∧ ¬(Deposit(OliveGarden, d) ∧ MoreOrEqual(d, 2000)) ::: Tom will rent an apartment in a managed building if allowed to move in with Fluffy, and the security deposit is no more than $1500.
AllowsPets(z) → PeopleAllowedWithPet(z) ::: If a managed building allows pets, then people are allowed to move in with a pet.
Conclusion:
AllowedToMoveIn(Tom, Fluffy) ::: Tom is allowed to move into an apartment in The Olive Garden with Fluffy.
